::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 1st [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 214-5[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I am obliged for the [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) which came safely this morning.

My dear [Mother](people/person_1606.qmd) died on Monday, the end coming much more suddenly than we had expected - and very mercifully to close the long course of feebleness of mind and body.

I do not think that I shall be able to do much steady work for some weeks to come, but after that, I hope to return to regular ways

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
